title: 情報ネットワーク
subtitle: Information Networks
educationalGoal: This course introduces the basic knowledge of information network technology supporting the information society. Students will get an overview of the services provided on the Internet and learn various related communication and security technologies, focusing on the hierarchical protocols essential for realizing the services. Through these, students will gain an understanding of what the Internet is like and acquire basic network operation techniques.
advice: Students will learn the basic knowledge related to computer networks as shown below. 1. Basic mechanisms of computer networks 2. TCP/IP hierarchy model and OSI reference model 3. Network service and application layer 4. Transport layer 5. Internet layer and routing 6. Network interface layer and hardware 7. Security
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to have credits of “Information Technology Basic” and “Introduction to Server Management”.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic mechanisms of computer networks.
Be able to explain the functions of each layer in the TCP/IP hierarchy model.
Be able to explain the protocol of the application layer that provides services such as Web and email.
Be able to explain the mechanism of data transfer at the transport, internet and network interface layer.
Be able to explain the security technology used on the Internet.
Be able to examine the network configuration using basic network commands and tools.
